title: Existing Automation Census & Gap Map
brief: Inventory slash commands by workflow. Inventory hook definitions + CCM planned work. Inventory core scripts by purpose. Identify partial chains and missing links between existing automation fragments.

units.title: Inventory all slash commands grouped by workflow (build, test, deploy, CAD, speed-feed, post, etc.)
Inventory hook definitions (existing + CCM planned) and map to automation lifecycle stages
Inventory core scripts by purpose (build guards, quality checks, context management, telemetry)
Cross-reference inventories to identify partial chains (commands with no post-validation, hooks with no follow-up)
Produce gap map document: missing links, unconnected fragments, chains that need wiring

exit_conditions: Complete inventory of slash commands, hooks, and scripts
Partial chains identified with specific missing links documented
Gap map produced showing what must be wired for full automation chains
